english.title: Enter a security restricted area of an aerodrome without permission of manager / person acting on his behalf
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, went on to part of a security restricted area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SECURITY RESTRICTED AREA..), of an aerodrome , namely **(..SPECIFY THE AERODROME ..), without the permission of the manager or person acting on behalf of the manager.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21C(1)(a) and (3) of the Aviation Security Act 1982.

english.notes:
(i) This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording document replaces CJS Code AV82054 and H4229 with effect from 29/04/2012 "restricted zone" amended to "security restricted area".
(ii) See section 21C(2) for exception..

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
